summary.content:
Today's selection covers 69 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 48 on Artificial Intelligence and 18 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: ChatGPT’s Computer History tracks your clicks and keystrokes
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: New AmnesiaStealer macOS malware hijacks browser sessions via remote control
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, BBC Technology, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 8 articles published in the last 24 hours
